timeline.text: Welcome to Greening Out. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: My body feels like it’s spiraling right now.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My heart is racing and it’s scary.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Part of me feels like this won’t end.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I feel disconnected from my body right now.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My stomach feels unsettled right now.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m scared of how intense this feels.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me feels like I did something wrong.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit this feels really overwhelming.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This panic is loud right now, and that’s real.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can remind myself that this will pass.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My heart is racing, and I’m still safe.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I don’t have to fight this feeling, I can just let it move through.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can feel my feet on the ground right now.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is working hard, and it will settle.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to feel scared without it meaning something is truly wrong.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I don’t need to judge myself for how I feel right now.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can breathe slowly and let my body catch up.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This intensity is temporary, even though it doesn’t feel like it.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I’m capable of riding this out.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I trust that my body knows how to come back to calm.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to just wait this out gently.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can feel this moment slowly starting to ease.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is already beginning to settle.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m learning that I can get through moments like this.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can be patient with myself until this passes.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m safe, even while my body finishes calming down.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to feel steady again.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. This is passing. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
